brochure.notes: No official prospectus or brochure PDF on dsmedicalcollege.org (checked 2026-10-25/26). The site's PDFs are NIRF 2023 data, MARB NMC pro-forma, committee lists and student name lists; the 'Tuition Fees' and 'Apply Now' items link no document. The Tamil Nadu Selection Committee's 2026-27 MBBS/BDS prospectuses (https://tnmedicalselection.net/news/30062026003157.pdf, 8,455,645 bytes; https://tnmedicalselection.net/news/28062026235144.pdf, 2,782,818 bytes) are government documents covering all colleges, not the college's own brochure, so they are not proposed for the lead-gated brochure slot.
